items.name: accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

items.name: accordion-css
items.description: CSS styles providing animations for the accordion component.

items.name: accordion-list
items.description: A pre-styled component that utilizes the accordion primitive to display a list of collapsible items.

items.name: alert
items.description: Displays a short, important message in a way that attracts the user's attention without interrupting their task.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

items.name: alert-dialog-modal
items.description: A pre-styled modal component built using the Alert Dialog primitive for critical user notifications.

items.name: alert-status
items.description: A component that leverages the alert primitive to display status messages (e.g., success, error, warning).

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: Displays content within a desired ratio, regardless of the content's original size.

items.name: avatar
items.description: An image element with a fallback for representing a user or entity.

items.name: button
items.description: An interactive element that triggers an action or event when clicked.

items.name: card
items.description: A container that groups related content and actions about a single subject.

items.name: class-names
items.description: A utility library for conditionally joining CSS class names together.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a content area.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: Displays a menu to the user —such as a set of actions or functions—triggered by a right-click.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.

items.name: dialog-modal
items.description: A pre-styled modal component built using the Dialog primitive for displaying custom content or forms.

items.name: drawer
items.description: A dismissible sidebar that slides in from the edge of the screen, often used for navigation or supplemental content.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: Displays a menu to the user—such as a list of actions or functions—triggered by a button.

items.name: footer
items.description: A standard footer component, typically used for copyright information, navigation links, or site map.

items.name: form
items.description: Provides structure for building accessible and validated forms, integrating with dynamic form hooks and validation utilities.

items.name: header
items.description: A standard header component, often containing branding, navigation, and user actions.

items.name: home-hello
items.description: A pre-built landing page template demonstrating a basic 'Hello Aura' setup.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

items.name: input
items.description: A foundational component for user text input.

items.name: label
items.description: Renders an accessible label associated with a form control.

items.name: layout-pancake
items.description: A full-page layout component featuring a header, main content area, and footer, often including progress indicators.

items.name: menubar
items.description: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.

items.name: n-progress
items.description: A customizable progress bar component for Next.js applications, providing visual feedback during page transitions and data loading.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.description: A collection of links for navigating websites, often used in site headers.

items.name: popover
items.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button. Can be used for dropdowns, tooltips, and more.

items.name: progress
items.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.

items.name: section
items.description: A semantic component used to group related content, often utilizing a wrapper for consistent spacing and styling.

items.name: select
items.description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.

items.name: separator
items.description: Visually or semantically separates content.

items.name: slider
items.description: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.

items.name: switch
items.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

items.name: tabs
items.description: A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.

items.name: toast
items.description: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily to provide brief feedback about an operation.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A two-state button that can be either on or off.

items.name: Togglebar
items.description: A container for grouping related Toggle buttons, often used for creating toolbars or mode switching interfaces.

items.name: ToggleGroup
items.description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off. Can be constrained to allow only one or multiple toggles at a time.

items.name: Tooltip
items.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

items.name: use-dynamic-form
items.description: A React hook providing a flexible state management solution for dynamic forms with diverse field types and validation.

items.name: web-validation
items.description: A library for client-side data validation using AJV, supporting JSON Schema and various formats.

items.name: wrapper
items.description: A general-purpose container component used for layout and spacing of its children.
